About Pyyne

Pyyne is a modern technology consultancy engineering the next generation of digital products and services.

At Pyyne, we believe in using technology to unlock business potential, create sustainable growth, and drive forward digital excellence. Our solutions range from advanced Software Engineering, Cloud, and Data & AI solutions.

Job Summary

Pyyne is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, skilled in Python and with experience developing solutions with LLMs to work as a Consultant out of our Brazilian Office. This is a high-impact role for Pyyne as we scale up our AI Services and onboard new and exciting clients in this sector. 

A successful candidate in this role will be self-motivated and responsible for the full product lifecycle, from architecting scalable systems to rapid prototyping and experimentation. If you are passionate about building robust, high-quality systems and want to make a significant impact on an innovative product, this role is for you. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect & Build : Design, develop, and deploy scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP that serve as the backbone for our AI-powered products.
  • Develop AI Solutions: Implement and optimize sophisticated AI systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI agents, to solve complex client problems.
  • Innovate & Experiment: Rapidly prototype and experiment with cutting-edge LLM-based solutions, including prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and tool integration.
  • Champion Code Quality: Take ownership of the development lifecycle and champion best practices for writing clean, well-tested, and maintainable code.
  • Collaborate & Lead: Work closely with product, data, and business stakeholders to shape the AI product roadmap and provide technical leadership.

Must Have Skills: 

  • Expert-Level Python: 3+ years of professional experience with deep, demonstrated expertise in Python and its ecosystem for building robust APIs and data-driven applications.
  • Production Cloud Experience: A proven track record of designing, building, and deploying scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP. You are comfortable with core services like Lambda/Cloud Functions, S3/Cloud Storage, EC2/Compute Engine, etc.
  • Hands-On AI Experience: You have built and shipped at least one AI-powered feature or application, demonstrating your ability to translate AI concepts into real-world solutions.
  • Engineering Excellence: You are a self-starter who takes ownership, writes
  • high-quality, maintainable code, and has a keen eye for detail.

Nice to Have Skills: 

  • Applied AI Development: Hands-on experience developing solutions with LLMs (e.g. via OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere APIs) and/or agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google ADK).
  • AI Infrastructure: Familiarity with services like AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI.
  • Vector Databases: Knowledge of vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) and semantic search concepts.
  • Modern DevOps: Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

Benefits:

  • Salary Range from 3,443 - 4,120 USD/mo
  • Flexible remote working environment.
  • Career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.

Como parceiro de desenvolvimento da solução, somos altamente qualificados para orientar empresas em todo o processo de implementação e ajudá-las a alcançar alto grau de automação em prêmios, provisões, cálculo de comissões, processamento de sinistros e relatórios.

Nossos consultores atuam em situações de negócio complexas e internacionais, influenciam decisões estratégicas e interagem diretamente com os clientes para compreender seus processos operacionais e requisitos funcionais. Oferecemos a profissionais ambiciosos um ambiente dinâmico, desafiador, com trilhas de carreira claras e amplas oportunidades de crescimento.

O que você fará

• Analisar processos de negócio e traduzi-los em especificações funcionais para o SAP FS-RI

• Configurar estruturas de resseguro proporcional e não proporcional (quota share, surplus, stop-loss, XL, retrocessão)

• Manter e configurar objetos essenciais do FS-RI: contratos, acordos, fluxos de caixa, eventos e lógicas de contabilização

• Garantir a integração entre FS-RI e módulos/sistemas adjacentes

• Conduzir workshops com stakeholders para definição de escopo, requisitos e análises de gap

• Apoiar a migração de dados: estruturas, contratos legados, saldos, provisões técnicas e histórico de sinistros

• Executar testes funcionais e de regressão, validando contabilizações financeiras

• Prestar suporte pós-go-live e durante o hypercare, assegurando estabilização dos processos

• Aplicar conhecimento sólido em contabilidade de resseguro, relatórios SUSEP, provisões técnicas e processos de fechamento financeiro

• Trabalhar com times de Finanças e Atuarial para validar cálculos de prêmios cedidos, comissões, recuperações, reservas e movimentações de sinistros

• Atuar como ponte entre áreas de negócio, TI, parceiros de implementação e patrocinadores do projeto

O que buscamos

Requisitos

• Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência relevante em consultoria SAP, preferencialmente em módulos como FS-RI, FS-CD ou FI-GL

• Graduação em Contabilidade, Administração, Economia, Atuária, Relações Internacionais, TI ou áreas correlatas

• Experiência prática em configuração funcional e testes do SAP FS-RI ou sistemas similares de resseguro

• Sólido entendimento de contratos proporcionais e não proporcionais, contabilidade de resseguro e requisitos regulatórios

• Experiência em ciclos completos de implementação SAP (Blueprint → Construção → Testes → Go-live → Hypercare)

• Habilidade para gerenciar múltiplas demandas simultaneamente

• Inglês avançado

Diferenciais

• Conhecimento em SAP FS-RI, FPSL, PaPM ou S/4HANA Finance

• Experiência em seguradoras ou resseguradoras multinacionais

• Familiaridade com grandes volumes de dados e ferramentas de migração

• Conhecimento de SAP HANA

O que oferecemos

• Um lugar onde os indivíduos são igualmente valorizados e onde a diversidade e as diferenças culturais são valorizadas.

• Uma equipe global de especialistas altamente respeitados da SAP e do setor, onde você pode fazer a diferença.

• Receba um pacote salarial atrativo e competitivo, incluindo pagamento de incentivos e outros benefícios aos funcionários (Plano de Saúde e Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação, Previdência Privada, Wellhub, Auxílio Home Office, Acesso ao SESC, Udemy Business).

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Enterprise Architect , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo .

In this role you will:

The Enterprise Architect will be centrally responsible for the strategic definition and implementation of Canada's enterprise architecture, working from the design and governance of systems to the integration of technological platforms and operational mining processes. Its mission is to translate business objectives into modern, secure and scalable architectures, aligned with international standards and the automation, sustainability and innovation goals of the group.

This professional will work in partnership with the global Enterprise Architect and cross-functional areas (IT, Operations, Engineering, ESG), ensuring that each solution offers efficient integration between on-premises, cloud, and industrial automation environments. He will have a profound influence on technology decisions, playing an advisory role with Canadian and Brazilian leadership, promoting a collaborative, innovative and results-oriented environment.

To succeed, you must demonstrate strategic vision, technical leadership, exceptional intercultural communication skills, and mastery of regulatory requirements in both Canada and Brazil.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve integrated Enterprise Architecture models (business, applications, data, technology), using frameworks such as TOGAF/ArchiMate and aligning with the strategic demands of mining, sustainability and digital transformation.
  • Act as a technical reference, leading cross-functional teams, promoting the consolidation of solutions between IT, OT and industrial automation, ensuring adherence to global corporate standards.
  • Evaluate and validate new technologies, platforms, services and methods (Cloud, Edge Computing, Digital Twins, IoT, Analytics, Cybersecurity), always considering the best practices in the mineral and natural resources sector.
  • Develop and maintain architectural criteria that prioritize security, regulatory compliance (LGPD, PIPEDA, GDPR), performance, sustainability and operational integration between Canada and Brazil.
  • Prepare detailed documentation (LLD/HLD, reference architectures, guidelines), transferring knowledge and mentoring technical and business teams both locally and internationally.
  • Lead communication between technical, operations, engineering, and global leaders, promoting efficient collaboration and respecting cultural differences.
  • Continuously analyze technological, regulatory and business trends, proposing standards and improvements that position as an international reference in sustainable and digital mining.
  • Participate directly in the supplier selection/merger processes, prioritizing interoperability, innovation and return on investment in critical projects.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Proven experience (minimum of 8 years in IT, with at least 5 as an enterprise architect or similar strategic role in Large Enterprise or mining/resources).
  • Deep knowledge of the mineral, energy or industrial sector, preferably previous experience in large global operations (e.g., Petrobras, Rio Tinto, Barrick Gold, Anglo American).
  • Mastery of the main enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF: Practitioner, ArchiMate, Zachman, DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Excellence in the use of cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) and data platforms, cross-system integration (ERP SAP/Oracle, SCADA, IIoT, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse).
  • Ability to design hybrid architectures (on-premises, cloud, edge), industrial data integration (sensing, automation, dashboards, analytics).
  • Strong performance in compliance, industrial cybersecurity (OT/IT Convergence), data protection, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Experience in multinational/cross-border projects, especially Brazil-Canada.
  • Fluent English (technical communication, executive meetings, documentation), advanced Portuguese is a strategic differential for integration between teams.

Soft Skills

  • Advanced communication skills, capable of transmitting complex technical concepts to different audiences (executives, engineers, IT, business).
  • Global strategic vision, aligning local and global initiatives with corporate objectives in sustainable mining, innovation and automation.
  • Analytical and solution-oriented thinking, with high ability to navigate complex, multifunctional and multicultural environments.
  • Collaborative leadership – mentoring, consensus building, influence without direct authority, and excellent internal/external networking skills.
  • Management of priorities, organization and resilience in the face of multiple parallel projects and ad-hoc demands.
  • Absolute focus on results, delivering tangible value for operation, innovation and sustainability.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • TOGAF (Expert) certification, AWS/Azure/GCP Solution Architect, CISA, PMP/Agile, specializations in ESG, digital mining, cyber OT/IT.
  • Hands-on experience with emerging platforms: Digital Twins, AI/ML/Ops, real-time streaming (Kafka, Spark Streaming, Flink), infrastructures as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Experience in due diligence processes, merger & acquisition, integration of multi-company systems.
  • Active participation in architecture forums, mining, global events, technical publications or international presentations.
  • Background with SAP, Oracle, SIEMENS, Rockwell, GE Predix, Azure IoT/Edge/Analytics solutions, sustainability frameworks and ESG reporting.

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Align the needs of global business, Canada and Brazil with the vision of enterprise architecture and technological roadmap.
  • Ensure that all solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, performance, regulatory compliance and operational excellence.
  • To be an agent of transformation and innovation, proposing disruptive solutions to digital and operational challenges in the mining sector.
  • Mentor and develop technical capacity of the teams, promoting architecture culture, documentation and standardization.
  • Lead the preparation and presentation of business cases, technical justifications and architectural alternatives to senior executives and regional and global boards.
  • Organize, sustain and evolve architecture governance, support strategic decisions and ensure the permanent alignment of solutions with business objectives and international compliance.

Additional Comments:

This is a key role in Canada's technological and cultural transformation, requiring active action in multicultural environments, with flexibility for travel, meetings in different time zones and continuous adaptation to trends in the mining sector and global architecture. The presence of fluent English is mandatory, while mastery of Portuguese enhances Brazil-Canada integration, directly impacting the success of the project. Technical certifications, previous experience in operations, participation in modernization/digitalization initiatives and innovative mindset will be major differentials in the selection process.

title: Consultor de Vendas | Mercado Financeiro
description:
O Clube do Valor foi fundado em 2015 com o objetivo de mudar, de verdade, a relação do brasileiro com o dinheiro. Com o passar do tempo, erramos e aprendemos muito. Entendemos que, pra gente, o que importa mesmo são duas coisas: propósito (o que nos move) e cultura (o que somos e como agimos).

Nosso propósito é ambicioso: levar tranquilidade financeira para todos os brasileiros, para que cada um possa viver a vida dos seus sonhos. Para nos aproximarmos do nosso propósito, atuamos em duas frentes complementares: educação e gestão de investimentos. Já impactamos mais de 40 mil brasileiros com nossos conteúdos e atingimos a marca de 5 bilhões de patrimônio sob gestão e aconselhamento.

NOSSOS VALORES

Nosso conjunto de valores reflete o que é empreender e ser um sócio que gera VALOR para o CDV:

V alorizamos resultados, trabalho duro e inteligente;

A ssumimos o protagonismo do nosso crescimento;

L evamos integridade e transparência em tudo o que fazemos;

O bstinados em superar as expectativas de todos os Clubistas (clientes e audiência);

R econhecemos de forma meritocrática quem age como dono.

O QUE BUSCAMOS EM VOCÊ:

Ensino superior ou técnico cursando/completo (qualquer curso);

Bom domínio da língua portuguesa, escrita e comunicação em geral;

Interesse/conhecimento mínimo sobre investimentos e finanças pessoais;

Abertura a desenvolvimento;

Perfil comercial e analítico;

Bom relacionamento interpessoal;

Residência em Porto Alegre/Região.

SOBRE A VAGA:

O Clube do Valor oferece um Programa de Formação de Planejadores Financeiros (PFP) estruturado em cinco fases. Ao longo dessa jornada, você passará por uma imersão intensiva, desenhada para acelerar o desenvolvimento das suas habilidades comerciais, relacionais e técnicas, por meio de experiências teóricas e práticas. Durante todo o processo, você contará com o apoio da nossa área de Enablement, além do financiamento da certificação CEA oferecido pelo CDV.

Nosso objetivo é que você seja formado para atuar como um Planejador Financeiro, levando tranquilidade financeira para todos os brasileiros.

FASE 1: Onboarding e Foco Institucional

O objetivo dessa etapa é a sua integração na empresa, engajamento com o time, com a nossa cultura e o direcionamento dos seus primeiros passos na trilha de formação.

Seus principais focos serão:

Onboarding Institucional;

Imersão Cultural;

Onboarding de Pré-Vendas.

FASE 2: Máquina de Vendas

Nessa etapa, você será responsável pela qualificação dos investidores, focando no desenvolvimento de habilidades comerciais e geração de novas oportunidades de negócios.

Seus principais focos serão:

Desenvolver habilidades comerciais.

Realizar agendamentos;

Pitch comercial;

Geração de oportunidades;

Foco em resultado e atingimento de metas.

FASE 3: Especialista em Investimentos

O objetivo dessa etapa é a sua capacitação técnica, seja na visão geral do mercado financeiro, investimentos ou operacional.

Seus principais focos serão:

Conhecimento geral sobre o Mercado Financeiro;

Conquista da certificação CEA;

Estudo da Filosofia e Estratégias de Investimentos do CDV;

Conhecimento de BackOffice e Ferramentas Operacionais.

FASE 4: Especialista em Novos Negócios

O objetivo dessa etapa é a sua capacitação para atendimento e relacionamento com o cliente.Você segue se desenvolvendo comercialmente e também aprende a realizar um fechamento comercial e começa a formar sua base de clientes.

Seus principais focos serão:

Jornada e Relacionamento com o Cliente;

Fechamento Comercial;

Elaboração de Planejamento Financeiro.

FASE 5: Jornada do Cliente

O objetivo dessa etapa é seguir a sua capacitação para atendimento e relacionamento com o cliente, desenvolvendo a postura e a conduta de um planejador.

Seus principais focos serão:

Jornada e Relacionamento com o Cliente;

description:
O que é Gerência de Planejamento Centrais da Porto?

Integrando a Diretoria Comercial de Canais Diferenciados, a Gerência de Planejamento Centrais tem a atribuição de desenhar e acompanhar a atuação dos times das mesas de negócios e estruturas matriciais, buscando maximização de performance de vendas e produção, bem como de analisar indicadores, receitas, custos, resultados e eficiência da distribuição dos produtos para report e direcionamento aos executivos do Grupo Porto, Banco Itaú, corretores, gestores da VP Comercial e das verticais de negócios.

Seus principais desafios serão:

  • Gestão de equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Relacionamento com clientes internos e externos para acompanhamento dos negócios e desenhos de escopo;
  • Disponibilizar e coordenar dados e análises segmentadas, discutir hipóteses, propor e acompanhar iniciativas para melhoria de performance e eficiência;
  • Utilizar técnicas e insights orientados por dados na gestão de planejamento de atuação, focado em conversão das vendas;
  • Direcionar a criação de réguas de propensão e segmentação para mensuração de resultados;
  • Produzir orçamento por segmento e canal, avaliando oportunidades e viabilidade desde a linha de receita individual até o lucro final;
  • Distribuição de metas de vendas individuais e por negócio;

  • Apoio no monitoramento em tempo real dos indicadores operacionais de call center (SLA, TMO, Volume, TME, HC, Pausas e Abandono);

  • Direcionar construção de painéis e relatórios recorrentes de acompanhamento para clientes internos e externos, utilizando bases analíticas;
  • Direcionar desenvolvimento e análise de retorno de projetos da estrutura e/ou entrada de novos parceiros e produtos, desenhando projeções, precificando serviços, e orientando a viabilidade para breakeven de custos e resultados;

O que você precisa para fazer parte deste time:

- Cloud Computing (preferencialmente AWS, Azure ou GCP)

- Banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais

- Forte conhecimento em metodologias Agile/Scrum/Kanban, gestão de backlog e métricas de produtividade técnica (lead time, throughput, qualidade de código).

- Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

- Certificações desejáveis: Scrum Master, AWS Solutions Architect, DevOps, Cloud Practitioner ou similares.

- Excelentes habilidades de liderança, comunicação assertiva, gestão de conflitos, visão sistêmica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

- Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de atuar estrategicamente e operacionalmente quando necessário.

- Proatividade, curiosidade tecnológica e capacidade de inspirar e engajar pessoas em torno de objetivos comuns.

title: Domain Architect Host and Cloud
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Domain Architect Host and Cloud, who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo .

In this role you will:

The Domain Architect – Host and Cloud is responsible for structuring, governing, and accelerating the integration of on-premises infrastructures, data centers, and cloud environments of Brasil and Canada's operations. Its role is to ensure robustness, resilience, security, and scalability in sustaining the main systems, supporting digitalization, automation, energy optimization, ESG, and industrial innovation projects.

He will work directly on critical migration, modernization and platform integration projects, leading best practices in cloud computing, edge/fog, hybrid architecture, infrastructure automation, regulatory compliance and performance. This professional will have a strategic role with the global IT, technical operations, security, and business teams, sustaining and transforming multi-site and multicultural technological environment.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve host (mainframe, midrange, industrial servers) and cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP, Oracle Cloud) infrastructure architecture standards, aligned with global demands and multi-cloud/hybrid strategies.
  • Lead digital transformation projects, including migration of on-premises loads to the cloud, integration of critical infrastructures, automation, containerization, DevOps and continuous improvement of environments.
  • Orchestrate the implementation of solutions oriented to resilience, cybersecurity, scalability, disaster recovery, advanced backup and cost optimization.
  • Ensure adherence to international security standards (ISO 27001, NIST, LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA) and best practices in data governance and operations.
  • Support the design and implementation of robust network, storage, virtualization, automation, edge/fog topologies in complex and distributed environments.
  • Develop and maintain advanced technical documentation: diagrams, manuals, processes, automation templates, observability policies, and operational standards.
  • Follow trends and innovation in cloud, edge, intelligent infrastructure, green IT and automation, evaluating adoption opportunities in operations.
  • Direct interface with Operations, Engineering, DevOps, Security, Business and global architecture teams.
  • Produce complete documentation, guides, contingency plans, training, and best practices for support and operation teams.
  • Participate in forums, workshops, and innovation projects to keep the technological environment in line with global trends.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Higher education in Engineering, Computer Science, Systems or related areas.
  • Minimum experience of 8 years in technological infrastructure architecture, with relevant performance in complex multi-cloud environments, critical data centers and automation.
  • Mastery of architecture, automation and management of hybrid environments (on-prem, cloud, colocation, edge/fog) at corporate scale, with hands-on experience in Azure, AWS, GCP.
  • Solid track record in network governance, storage, virtualization, backup, industrial topologies, data protection and technological integration of critical environments (OT/IT).
  • Real experience in projects to migrate systems, workloads or data centers to the cloud, with planning, execution and monitoring of results.
  • Excellence in infrastructure automation (Terraform, Ansible, ARM, CloudFormation), observability, cycled and advanced monitoring.
  • Practice with compliance and security: zero-trust, IAM, encryption, vulnerability management, disaster recovery.
  • Fluent English (essential), advanced Portuguese/Spanish desirable for Brazil-Canada integration.

Soft Skills

  • Technical leadership, positive influence and ability to build consensus across areas, countries and cultures.
  • Strategic and analytical capacity to design efficient, secure and business-aligned solutions.
  • Clear and efficient communication with stakeholders, from technical leadership to global executive levels.
  • Proactivity, autonomy and adaptability for dynamic and multicultural environments.
  • Focus on value delivery, continuous improvement and innovation.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Certification: Azure/AWS/GCP Architect, VMware, Cisco, LPIC, TOGAF, ITIL Expert.
  • Experience with OT/IT integration (industrial environments, mining, remote automation), edge/fog.
  • Experience with architectures for sustainability: Green IT, energy saving, resource optimization.
  • Previous experience in mainframe/midrange modernization projects, containerization, SRE/metrics.
  • Participation in global forums, technical communities, presentations, publications.

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Detailed reference architecture for host and cloud environments, including integration, automation, observability, and resiliency solutions.
  • Execution of strategic migration and modernization projects with a focus on performance, innovation, compliance and operational excellence.
  • Support for the adoption of global standards of governance, security and cost/efficiency optimization in the Brazil and Canada environments.
  • Dissemination of good practices, technical mentoring for internal teams and continuous training.
  • Acting as an innovation agent, aligning technological evolution with sustainability, security, scalability and business results.

Additional Comments:

This role is central to the digital transformation, sustainability, automation and integration of critical environments between Brazil and Canada. It requires strategic, technical and multicultural action, with protagonism in complex environments, willingness to innovate and a strong sense of global partnership.

Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

We are looking for a Domain Architect Operations Technology , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo.

In this role you will:

The Domain Architect – Operation Technology is fundamental to the architecture, governance and evolution of operational technology solutions and infrastructures in the mining operations of Brasil and Canada. This professional will lead the integration of traditional OT systems (SCADA, DCS, PLCs) with emerging technologies of industrial IoT, industrial cloud, advanced automation and OT cybersecurity.

Its mission is to ensure safe, resilient, integrated industrial operations aligned with global digital strategy, supporting innovations in mining 4.0, sustainability, operational efficiency and digital transformation. He will work collaboratively with technical, security, IT and business areas at the multinational level.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and govern OT architectures, ensuring alignment between industrial systems, automation, IoT sensors and integration with IT and Cloud.
  • Design solutions for real-time control, monitoring, automation and analysis of industrial processes, ensuring high availability and resilience.
  • Lead modernization projects, edge/cloud OT integration, digital twins, predictive analytics, cognitive automation, and operational security.
  • Assess and implement global OT security standards (NIST, IEC 62443), vulnerability management, and industrial cyber incident response.
  • Foster alignment between OT and IT teams to promote secure, efficient, and scalable integration of operational technologies.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, contingency plans, operational guides, and OT governance policies.
  • Participate in the definition of strategies for technological innovation, sustainability and reduction of environmental impact.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and strategic partners on critical OT solutions, ensuring system interoperability.
  • Train technical teams and promote a culture of safety and OT innovation in global operations.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Computing, Industrial Systems or related areas.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in architecture, engineering, or operational technology leadership in industrial or mining sectors.
  • In-depth knowledge of OT systems: SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, IoT sensors, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, Profibus).
  • Expertise in OT/IT integration, edge computing architectures, digital twins, advanced automation, predictive analytics and Industrial Big Data.
  • Solid domain in OT cybersecurity, IEC 62443 frameworks, NIST, incident management and operational continuity.
  • Knowledge in industrial cloud platforms (Azure IoT, AWS IoT, Google Cloud Industrial) and OT modernization.
  • Experience with governance, regulatory compliance, sustainability and ESG standards in the mining and process industry.
  • Fluent English for global communication and advanced Portuguese for Brazil-Canada work.

Soft Skills

  • Technical and consultative leadership, negotiation skills and influence in multicultural and multidisciplinary environments.
  • Strategic vision to connect OT technological innovation to business, safety and sustainability.
  • Clear and effective communication to diverse stakeholders and technical and executive teams.
  • Proactivity, resilience, critical thinking and focus on sustainable and safe results.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Technical certifications in OT (ISA/IEC 62443, Certified Automation Professional, Cybersecurity Certifications).
  • Experience with industrial digital platforms, analytics, AI/ML applied to operation.
  • Experience in operations or in large-scale mining.
  • Ability to conduct global projects with multiple teams and stakeholders.

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Robust architecture and governance of OT solutions, supporting Brazil and Canada operations with security and innovation.
  • Leadership in OT digital transformation projects aiming at sustainability, automation and operational efficiency.
  • Support OT/IT integration, compliance, and governance of critical operations.
  • Dissemination of OT governance and global technical capacity building.
  • Increased resilience, safety and efficiency of industrial operations.

Additional Comments:

The OT Domain Architect is a key player in the technological and sustainable evolution of industrial operations, working in complex and global environments. Technical expertise, strategic vision, and collaborative capabilities are essential to strengthen technological leadership in the mining and energy sectors.

Volcafe ltd é uma das principais empresas internacionais de comércio de café verde do mundo, operando em mais de 20 países globalmente, atuando na compra, exportação, bem como na importação e distribuição para os principais mercados do mundo. Fazemos parte do Grupo ED&F Man , um trader líder mundial de commodities agrícolas que comercializa café, açúcar e melaço.

Também oferecemos salário e benefícios competitivos combinados com excelentes oportunidades de desenvolvimento de carreira em uma das líderes globais em negociação de commodities agrícolas.

Respeito, Integridade, Meritocracia, Foco no Cliente, Empreendedorismo

A Volcafe compartilha os valores de nossa empresa matriz, ED&F Man Commodities. Nossos valores definem quem somos. Eles influenciam a forma como nos comunicamos e colaboramos e definem a forma como nos relacionamos com nossos clientes, parceiros e comunidades.

Nosso compromisso

A Volcafe compartilha o compromisso de nossa empresa controladora, ED&F Man Commodities. Estamos empenhados em criar e manter um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diversificado, onde todos os funcionários sejam tratados com dignidade e respeito. description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.

We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!

This is a large impact role that demands someone who can excel in a fast paced and ever changing environment.

Title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager

Location: Brazil, remote

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate

The Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager is a strategic role responsible for the planning, execution, and operational success of the organization's IT Infrastructure initiatives and daily operations. This individual will manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, ensuring they align with strategic business objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-10% travel as per business requirements.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience in managing geographically dispersed or matrixed teams.
  • Jira, Confluence

title: Administrador de Banco de Dados DBA Pl/Sr
description:
Você na Deloitte!

Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo atuando como Administrador de Banco de Dados DBA Pl/Sr.

Na Deloitte, buscamos pessoas que queiram gerar resultados positivos todos os dias. Impulsionamos talentos para que possam se desenvolver em um ambiente colaborativo, com tempos diversos e que tragam energia, empoderamento, interação e conexões. O nosso crescimento é exponencial porque os talentos que recrutamos possuem os nossos valores em suas essências.

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que nos preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. O que fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto .

Administrador de Banco de Dados DBA Pl/Sr

  • Experiência na administração de bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra ou similares) em ambientes on-premises e em nuvem (AWS RDS/Aurora, Azure SQL, GCP Cloud SQL);
  • Proficiência em modelagem de dados, design de esquemas, indexação e otimização de queries SQL avançadas; Domínio de ferramentas e práticas de backup, restore e políticas de retenção, com testes periódicos de integridade e recuperação;
  • Vivência em automação de tarefas rotineiras de banco de dados (patching, upgrades, manutenção), utilizando scripts (Shell, PowerShell) e Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM Templates);
  • Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps para banco de dados, integrando pipelines CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) para deploy de alterações de esquema e dados;
  • Conhecimento em segurança e compliance de dados, incluindo criptografia em repouso e em trânsito, gerenciamento de usuários/roles, auditoria de acessos e conformidade com LGPD;
  • Conhecimento em containerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes) de ambientes de banco de dados será considerado diferencial;
  • Habilidade em documentar procedimentos, elaborar runbooks e treinar equipes de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura.

Formação Acadêmica: Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;

Local de Trabalho: Recife-(Hibrido 2 x por semana)

O que estará disponível para você?

Desenvolvimento Profissional

É claro que cuidamos do seu desenvolvimento aqui na Deloitte! Queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com a Universidade Corporativa, acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, oferecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais da Deloitte e seus dependentes.

Além disso, oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com mentoria de profissionais da Deloitte por meio de um(a) coach, que poderá ouvir seus desafios e apoiar para que consiga evoluir tanto com habilidades técnicas, quanto com habilidades comportamentais com base na própria experiência. É ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?

Cuidados com o seu bem-estar

Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com as pessoas, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:

  • Serviço de telemedicina para que você consiga fazer uma pré-avaliação sem precisar sair de casa!
  • Estratégia Familiar: programa destinado a profissionais gestantes e futuros papais que terá todo apoio possível neste momento tão especial
  • Wellhub (Gympass) para colocar os exercícios físicos em dia
  • Dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário, para comemorar uma das pessoas mais importantes de sua vida
  • Canal de apoio psicológico e Serviço Social

(Mais) Benefícios

  • Assistência médica e odontológica! Para que você faça check-ups e cuide de você, em primeiro lugar*
  • Participação nos lucros. Afinal, sem os nossos talentos, não pensamos crescer exponencialmente
  • Auxílio-internet, para apoiar no trabalho em modelo híbrido
  • Seguro de vida*
  • Vale refeição/alimentação*

Pacote de benefícios flexível : você receberá pontos e poderá distribuí-los entre as opções que melhor se adequam às suas necessidades de acordo com as regras do programa.

Oportunidade de fazer parte de uma cultura inclusiva

Você pode ser quem realmente é com oportunidade igual de crescimento. Para fortalecer esse compromisso, desenvolvemos uma estratégia global de D&I com os 5 pilares – Origens, Delas, LGBT+, Inclui e Gerações. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas estão abertas ao público PcD.

Esperamos que você nesta ocasião!

title: Financial Planning and Analysis Manager
description:
What's the role?

We’re seeking a bold, strategic finance leader who thrives in complexity and excels at business partnering. In this high-impact role, you’ll serve as a Finance Business Partner to the Market Organization, helping to steer financial levers and performance. We’re looking for passion about the construction industry with the creativity and courage to challenge the status quo and drive innovation from within. You’ll be working closely with senior executives to shape decisions, drive integration, and ensure long-term value creation. If you're looking for a growth platform within Hilti that could catapult you to future leadership roles, this is it. .

What does the role involve?

As a Finance Manager, you will:

  • Partner directly with functional leaders to shape and execute our growth strategy.
  • Lead the financial performance management cycle, including rolling forecasts and financial steering across sales divisions.
  • Analyze and advise on business cases, investments, and commercial strategies-turning data into action.
  • Own and improve the financial planning processes
  • Collaborate with senior stakeholders to identify operational bottlenecks, propose financial guardrails, and recommend course corrections.
  • Contribute to long-term planning initiatives
  • Ensure compliance and risk alignment while embedding agile, future-proof finance systems and structures.
  • Lead with influence-not authority-by asking challenging questions, probing assumptions, and helping senior stakeholders align on impactful choices.
  • Balance your time between strategic conversations and hands-on finance operations. This is not a traditional accounting role-it’s business partnering at its most influential.

What you need is:

  • Completed bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, or related field (CPA/CMA/CA is a plus). Master’s degree is a plus.
  • 7–10 years’ experience in finance, consulting, or audit-ideally within multinational organizations.
  • Strong strategic acumen with hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting, and business planning.
  • Proven success in business partnering roles—working alongside execs and cross-functional teams to drive real outcomes.
  • Ability to influence without authority, simplify complex financial topics, and communicate clearly in fluent English.

What you can expect when applying to a Hilti position:

When applying to a position at Hilti, you can expect a people-centric recruitment process where every application is reviewed by a human (automated notifications are triggered by our recruiting team). Personalized feedback isn’t provided for applications that don’t reach hiring manager interview stage, the overall process—including evaluations and interviews—typically takes 3 to 6 weeks, with most applicants hearing back within 2 to 3 weeks. For tips and more information, you’re encouraged to explore Hilti’s career FAQ section.

TapGoods

TapGoods is an exciting, fast-growing start-up that is revolutionizing how rental companies optimize and grow their businesses. We’re working to make it easy to rent. 

There are tens of thousands of businesses in the US that provide event, tool, audiovisual, and recreation rentals. This fragmented $722 billion global industry has not yet adopted modern systems and instead relies on pen & paper or cobbles together dated technology solutions. We’re building a solution that modernizes and dramatically improves the rental process for both businesses and their customers. 

Our product engineering team uses agile processes to continuously deliver incremental functionality on a weekly basis. We are constantly evolving, looking at every sprint as an opportunity to celebrate our success and learn how to improve. 

Data Analyst Role

We need a Data Analyst to join our team to fulfill our customers’ reporting needs. Our cloud platform provides analytics and reporting to our customers to help them manage their rental business. We’ve built a data warehouse and are moving our canned reports into embedded Power BI reports. 

This role would work closely with the product team and engineers to take our reporting to the next level. 

Responsibilities 

  • Use Power BI to create reports using our data warehouse 
  • Look for insights in our data that can provide value to our customers 
  • Maintain the Snowflake data warehouse dimensional model 
  • Be a part of our engineering team 
  • Able to work fully remote with adequate internet speeds, workspace, zoom capabilities (good mic, headset, etc.), and multiple monitors 

Requirements 

  • 1-3 years of experience with SQL 
  • Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools 
  • Experience with Power Query M 
  • Experience with Snowflake data warehouse 
  • Understanding data models for OLAP vs OLTP 
  • Experience with dimensional modeling/star schemas 
  • An unstoppable internal drive 
  • A great attitude and work ethic 
  • Solution oriented, self starter, and team player 
  • SaaS experience is a plus 

Our Culture

We are a nimble, fast-growing startup with a fully remote work environment. We have different backgrounds and life experiences that create a highly motivated, empowered and productive team. 

We are all committed to excellent work, whether it be one task or a big project - we believe in sticking things out until they are finished, and in communicating as quickly and effectively as possible when things get in the way of completing promised work. We are committed to improving the lives of our customers through our platform and our genuine care for them.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the Client

Our client is a global technology company specialized in large-scale cloud infrastructure, automation of distributed systems, and deep integration between hardware and software.

The engineering environment is highly technical, fast-paced, and built around autonomy, ownership, and solving complex infrastructure challenges at global scale.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer with a strong software engineering background and solid experience in automating complex infrastructure environments.

This is a high-impact, product-focused role , responsible for building tools, automation layers, APIs, and workflows that will be directly consumed by the company’s customers — not only internal teams.

This is not a traditional DevOps/Platform position focused on provisioning resources internally.

Here, you will be designing and engineering infrastructure automation as product , interacting with hardware, clusters, and low-level systems that power a global cloud offering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop tools, automations, APIs, and infrastructure workflows used directly by end customers.
  • Build automation layers that interact with physical hardware and low-level components (state management, provisioning logic, control sequences, etc.).
  • Create and maintain internal backends and integrations linking services, infrastructure, and the core platform.
  • Leverage programming languages — especially Python — to design robust and scalable automation solutions.
  • Work on the automation behind global infrastructure and distributed clusters.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and architectural decisions.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement within the platform and proactively propose solutions.

Technical Requirements

  • Senior-level experience in software development , especially with Python.
  • Strong background in infrastructure automation and distributed environments.
  • Experience working with hardware , data centers, bare-metal environments, or infrastructure-heavy companies.
  • Solid understanding of APIs, internal workflows, provisioning automation, and backend integrations.
  • Ability to work in low-level contexts involving hardware components and state management.
  • Proven experience building solutions from scratch , not only executing predefined tasks.

Cultural & Behavioral Profile

  • High autonomy: must be able to discover opportunities, define approaches, and drive solutions independently.
  • Seniority and maturity to operate within a team of highly experienced engineers.
  • Hands-on, proactive mindset, with strong ownership and problem-solving orientation.
  • Experience in fast-paced environments (startups or mixed small/large company backgrounds).
  • Curiosity and flexibility to learn new technologies and navigate cross-disciplinary areas.

English Requirement

  • Advanced English is mandatory , as the leadership and part of the engineering team are international.

What Will Not Fit

  • Junior or mid-level professionals.
  • Candidates who only worked in slow, highly structured corporate environments.
  • Profiles focused solely on execution or maintenance (not creation).
  • Professionals who depend heavily on direction and lack technical autonomy.

Contract Model

  • PJ / Contractor (LLC) — engagement through independent contractor arrangement.
  • The candidate must be legally able to invoice through a company (LLC or equivalent).

Work Model

  • Remote (remote-friendly).
  • The company has no restrictions regarding location, as long as the candidate meets performance expectations and availability for team collaboration.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on the core product , not just internal tooling.
  • Unique combination of software + hardware + global infrastructure engineering .
  • High autonomy and opportunity to design new components from scratch.
  • Collaboration with a senior, highly technical engineering team.

title: Quality Control Lead
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a structured, strict, and technically-minded Head of Quality Assurance who will build and lead one of the most critical operational units in the company.

Scope of responsibility:

  • Management of a team of 30+ remote assistants
  • Quality control of 5,000+ job applications/month (scaling to 10,000+)
  • Direct reporting to the CEO

Context & Challenges

Current situation:

  • 30 assistants submit job applications on behalf of clients
  • Quality is inconsistent—there is no systematic control
  • Many manual review processes → we need automation
  • No structured onboarding for new assistants
  • No clear KPIs or performance-based motivation

What must be built:

Audit the current team

Hire additional assistants

Build a full Quality Assurance system from scratch

Automate quality checks in collaboration with engineering

Implement onboarding, training, and control processes

Key Responsibilities

Build a Quality Assurance system (30%)

First 2 weeks:

  • Audit current assistants
  • Evaluate work quality (accuracy, speed, compliance)
  • Decide who stays, who leaves
  • Create quality criteria and checklists

Ongoing:

  • Implement regular quality audits and spot-checks
  • Establish KPIs (quality, speed, customer satisfaction)
  • Track quality metrics per assistant
  • Identify repeating errors and remove root causes
  • Review difficult cases with the team

Hiring & Onboarding (25%)

Hiring:

  • Design the hiring funnel (screening → test task → interview)
  • Hire new assistants within first 1–2 months
  • Maintain a candidate pipeline (no current churn, but may appear)

Onboarding & training:

  • Build a structured onboarding program (1–2 weeks)
  • Teach systems, standards, and workflows
  • Certify assistants before they start working with clients
  • Create training materials, videos, guides

Automation & Technology (20%)

Work with engineering team:

  • Identify which checks can be automated
  • Create clear requirements and tasks for developers
  • Test and launch automation tools
  • Utilize AI and scripts for monitoring

Automation examples:

  • Automatic validation of application fields
  • Duplicate application detection
  • Performance dashboards and speed tracking
  • Quality alert system
  • Real-time monitoring tools

Team Management (15%)

  • Workload distribution among assistants
  • KPI tracking and performance reviews
  • Escalation handling and issue resolution
  • Motivation and team culture development

People development:

  • Selective 1:1s
  • Coaching low performers
  • Promote top performers into team leads
  • Create internal career paths

Continuous improvement (10%)

  • Identify bottlenecks and improve processes
  • Implement best practices and standardization
  • Maintain operations documentation
  • Work with client complaints, root cause elimination

Requirements

Must-Have:

2+ years managing operational teams

  • Experience managing 20+ employees
  • Built processes from scratch
  • Preferably BPO/outsourcing/call center/EdTech

Strong systems thinking and discipline

  • SOPs, checklists, regulations, compliance
  • Precision and attention to detail
  • Ability to make difficult decisions (terminations, corrective action)

Technical competency

  • Understanding of automation & quality monitoring
  • Ability to write clear requirements for developers
  • Experience with CRM, monitoring dashboards, etc.
  • Nice-to-have: SQL basics, API logic, scripting

Analytical approach

  • Metrics: quality %, speed, productivity, error rate
  • KPI systems and reporting
  • Data-driven decision-making

Experience in hiring & onboarding

Strong Plus:

BPO/outsourcing experience (data entry, support, back office)

Quality automation experience

Technical degree (engineering / CS / math)

Six Sigma/Lean/Kaizen knowledge

Experience scaling teams from 10 → 50+

QA/Quality Management certifications

Experience with distributed remote teams

Descrição:

A está em busca de um(a) profissional com experiência prática em limpeza doméstica para colaborar como consultor(a) especialista em nossos guias de compra e artigos sobre produtos e ferramentas para o lar.

Entre os temas que abordamos estão limpadores para azulejos e rejuntes, repelentes de pragas, aspiradores de pó, máquinas de lavar e outros produtos usados no dia a dia da casa .

Como funciona a colaboração:

  • Questionário: responder um breve formulário online indicando os critérios mais importantes para escolher cada tipo de produto (efetividade, segurança, facilidade de uso, durabilidade, custo-benefício, o que evitar etc.).

Condições da colaboração:

  • Pagamento: R$ 350 por artigo (questionário + revisão).
  • Pagamento realizado até o dia 20 do mês seguinte à entrega.
  • Colaboração pontual, 100% remota.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada em limpeza e organização residencial , com conhecimento prático sobre produtos e utensílios domésticos.
  • Capacidade de emitir NFS-e de serviço de consultoria por CNPJ próprio fora do regime MEI .

Reportando-as ao Supervisor de Controladoria, é responsável pela consolidação dos custos industriais, validação de KPI’s financeiros para Operações, incluindo consolidação, validação, análise e preparação de relatórios, garantindo a qualidade dos dados e desenvolvimento de ferramentas para suportar estas atividades.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Consolidar os custos industriais das plantas da Ardagh nos processos de fechamento mensal, Budget e Reforecast trimestral, garantindo acuracidade das informações;
  • Preparar análises das variações e entendimento dos principais drivers de flutuação em cada mês, consolidando comentários para a gerência e diretoria de FP&A e operações;
  • Realizar a modelagem de retorno financeiro de projetos, incluindo demandas comerciais que envolvam customizações de produto;
  • Validar os KPI's financeiros que impactam na gestão das plantas, através da extração de dados de consumo, custos e modelagem em Excel;

Superior completo em Contabilidade, Administração, Engenharia ou Economia.

Inglês intermediário;

SAP – módulos FI (desejáveis), CO e FM (desejáveis);

Excel avançado;

Conhecimento em SAP FI e desejável CO/FM;

Conhecimento de custos industriais e rotina fabril;

Sobre a Ardagh:

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!

Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.

Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)

Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.

title: Engenheiro de IA - Junior
description:
A Tabas by Blueground está reinventando o mercado de aluguel de apartamentos para curta, média e longa estadia. Combinamos tecnologia, dados e hospitalidade para entregar uma experiência premium e fluida para nossos clientes. Somos uma empresa tech-first em rápida expansão, com desafios reais para aplicar IA generativa de forma prática e criativa.

Buscamos um(a) AI Chatbot Engineer Engineer para integrar nosso time de dados. Você nos ajudará a construir e evoluir chatbots baseados em agents LLM. Seu trabalho será criar e melhorar assistentes inteligentes, que conversem naturalmente com hóspedes e times internos, resolvam solicitações ponta a ponta e se integram aos nossos sistemas de reservas, manutenção, operações e financeiro. No seu dia a dia, você vai:

  • Desenvolver e manter agentes conversacionais usando LLMs (Large Language Models), frameworks de orquestração (Langchain Agents, CrewAI) e ferramentas de função/chamada externa
  • Implementar monitoramento, avaliação contínua e guard-rails para assegurar respostas seguras, úteis e alinhadas à empresa.
  • Integrar LLMs com sistemas de recuperação de informações (RAG) e OCR/document processing
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com engenheiros de dados, cientistas de dados e time de produto e explorar novas ideias e soluções criativas com foco em IA generativa aplicada ao mercado de real estate

Requisitos:

Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente no escritório da Tabas (Jardins/SP) 3x por semana

  • Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Matemática ou áreas correlatas
  • Inglês avanaçado
  • Experiência com Python e desenvolvimento de APIs (FastAPI, Flask ou similar)
  • Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial Generativa
  • Conhecimento prático de LLMs, engenharia de prompts e design de chatbots
  • Noções de bancos de dados relacionais (como PostgreSQL)
  • Mentalidade experimental, vontade de aprender rápido e colocar soluções em prática

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência ou certificações com GCP
  • Familiaridade com OpenAI, Hugging Face ou outras ferramentas de LLMs
  • Projetos usando LangChain Agents, LlamaIndex ou outras ferramentas de orquestração de agentes
  • Participação em projetos de pesquisa ou hackathons de IA
  • Noções de embeddings vetoriais , LangChain ou integração com bancos vetoriais

Tecnologias que usamos por aqui

  • Python (FastAPI, Flask), REST APIs, PostgreSQL, LLMs (OpenAI, Hugging Face), GCP (diferencial).

title: Desenhista mecânico

Dê a sua contribuição para neutralizar o carbono em mercados como de nuclear, energia, infraestrutura, saneamento e meio ambiente.

Está pronto para fazer a diferença? Então, estamos animados para conhecer você!

O que oferecemos

  • A Tractebel é mais do que um local de trabalho. É a sua oportunidade de evoluir ao lado de especialistas em projetos com impacto global . É um ambiente baseado no espírito de equipe, onde você pode atingir o seu potencial máximo.   • Sabemos que o equilíbrio saudável entre vida pessoal e profissional é fundamental para seu bem-estar. Por isso, você pode trabalhar de casa até 1 dia por semana e pode iniciar suas atividades entre 7h30 e 9h30 e encerrar entre 16h30 e 18h30, respectivamente.
  • Entre o primeiro dia útil do ano e a última sexta-feira antes do carnaval, a empresa adota a jornada especial de verão . Você poderá usufruir de uma jornada reduzida às sextas-feiras, mediante compensação.
  • Para celebrarmos momentos especiais e simplesmente nos divertirmos, realizamos ações em datas comemorativas, presenteamos você no seu aniversário, festejamos juntos em nossa confraternização de fim de ano e muito mais.

A sua missão

Como Desenhista Mecânico da área de Infraestrutura, você contribuirá para a nossa missão de construirmos juntos um futuro neutro em carbono todos os dias.

As suas principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e revisar desenhos técnicos mecânicos conforme normas e padrões internos.
  • Elaborar arranjos gerais e desenhos de detalhamento para fabricação.
  • Apoiar projetistas e engenheiros na definição de soluções construtivas.
  • Garantir a qualidade e precisão dos desenhos, observando requisitos de segurança e desempenho.

  • Conhecimento de Autocad;

  • Experiência prévia como desenhista mecânico, preferencialmente no setor de mineração ou caldeiraria pesada (desejável).

Quem somos

As nossas prioridades são as pessoas, a ética, a segurança e a sustentabilidade. Com a Tractebel, você pode ter um impacto positivo nos objetivos globais de neutralizar as emissões de carbono. O nosso maior ativo são os nossos empregados e a diversidade é a nossa força!

Saiba mais sobre a , as nossas atividades e o porquê de se deve juntar a nós!

Como parte do Grupo ENGIE , com 96.000 colaboradores, você terá oportunidades de trilhar seu caminho profissional sempre moldando um mundo mais sustentável.

title: Staff Accountant - Manufacturing
description:
Location:  Los Angeles, CA (remote)

Employment Type:  Full-Time

We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented  Entry-Level Staff Accountant  to join our growing team. This role is ideal for accountants seeking hands-on experience in manufacturing, inventory accounting, and operational finance.

As part of our accounting department, you’ll support day-to-day bookkeeping, assist with month-end close, work with inventory and COGS, and help analyze data from systems like QuickBooks and Shopify. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your accounting career in a fast-paced, product-driven environment.

Responsibilities

  • Assist with daily accounting tasks, including A/R, A/P, bank reconciliations, and general ledger entries
  • Work with QuickBooks Desktop or Online to record transactions, categorize expenses, and maintain accurate financial data
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities
  • Assist with inventory-related tasks, including COGS reporting, manufacturing inputs, and reconciliation of product data
  • Pull reports and data from Shopify and other internal systems
  • Prepare Excel reports, spreadsheets, and basic financial analyses
  • Collaborate with operations to understand manufacturing costs and workflows
  • Maintain organized financial records and contribute to process improvements across the accounting department

Requirements

  • AA degree in Accounting   or currently pursuing a  Bachelor’s degree in Accounting
  • Recent Excel or QuickBooks coursework (within 3 years)  OR current experience with QuickBooks Desktop/Online
  • Currently working in an accounting role  or actively progressing toward an accounting degree
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and time management
  • Comfort with Excel (basic formulas, creating spreadsheets, organizing financial data)
  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a manufacturing environment
  • Experience in manufacturing, inventory, or COGS accounting is a plus but not required
  • Experience using Shopify’s backend for reporting is a plus

Why Join Us?

  • Hands-on experience in real manufacturing and product accounting
  • Opportunity to learn inventory, costing, and operational accounting—not just data entry
  • Clear growth path within the accounting department
  • Dynamic, collaborative environment where your work directly supports production and company growth

Nossa Empresa, Somos a maior produtora de óleo sustentável da América Latina, reconhecida em todo o mundo pela qualidade superior de nossos produtos e processos, e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente e as pessoas. Geramos cerca de 5mil empregos diretos e desenvolvemos projetos socioambientais que impactam direta e indiretamente na vida de todos.

Temos operações no Pará e em São Paulo. Nossos plantios e fábricas de extração ficam situados em Tailândia/PA, onde iniciamos nossa trajetória em 1982. Também possuíamos modernas refinarias nas cidades de Belém/PA e Limeira/SP. Especificamente, na unidade de Limeira, temos uma refinaria multióleos, com equipamentos de última geração e um Centro de Inovação pronto para atender às indústrias de panificação, sorvetes, confeitaria, food service, lácteos, cosméticos e produtos não alimentícios (químicos e oleoquímicos).

Mais do que desenvolver produtos de qualidade, nosso objetivo é cooperar para um mundo melhor. Tanto que dos nossos 107 mil hectares de terra, destinamos 64 mil a áreas de reservas florestais preservadas e monitoradas, com riquíssima biodiversidade. Em Tailândia/PA, mantemos agrovilas com completa infraestrutura para nossos colaboradores, com escola, clubes e academia.

title: Marketing Manager
description:

  • Sales launched in Europe (Finland, Germany) — marketing needs localization

Content

  • Client case studies are produced irregularly
  • Need adaptation for new markets
  • Content quality must be stabilized and elevated

Processes

  • Expansion into new markets (Finland, Germany)
  • Strengthening position in the U.S.
  • Channel diversification and testing

Strategy & Leadership (30%)

  • Build quarterly / monthly / weekly marketing plans
  • Manage and mentor SMM, email, and paid traffic teams
  • Write briefs and task descriptions for creatives and specialists
  • Run regular syncs with team and stakeholders
  • Prioritize initiatives and ensure deadlines are met

Content & Creative (25%)

  • Develop content strategy for SMM, email, webinars, landing pages
  • Lead the production of case studies and educational content

  • Maintain a unified tone of voice

Lead Generation & Funnels (25%)

  • Build and optimize chatbot logic and conversion flows
  • Develop partnerships, media placements, and collaborations
  • Build CJMs and warming funnels

Analytics & Optimization (20%)

  • Analyze key metrics (CAC, CPL, conversions, ROI)

  • Test new channels and hypotheses
  • Work with analytics tools (GA, CRM, marketing platforms)

Must Have

Experience in EdTech or SaaS — 2+ years

  • Strong understanding of how educational/SaaS funnels work
  • B2C marketing experience in career/learning segments
  • Experience with performance metrics and ROI-oriented marketing

High-growth startup experience

  • Ability to work in a fast-changing environment
  • Skilled in prioritization and multitasking
  • Experience contributing to 2x–3x growth

Marketing team management — 1+ year

  • Ability to assign and brief tasks clearly
  • Coordination of cross-functional stakeholders
  • Delegation and performance oversight

Tools & technical marketing skills

  • Email marketing (Klaviyo, SendGrid, or similar)
  • Chatbots and automation funnels
  • Analytics (Google Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel)
  • SMM + paid advertising experience
  • Webflow / Figma / Notion for content collaboration

CJM & funnel expertise

  • Experience designing customer journey maps
  • Building content-based nurturing funnels
  • Understanding of CAC, LTV, ROMI, conversion metrics

Strong Plus

Experience running webinars and online events

Copywriting and editing skills

Knowledge of U.S./EU job markets

Experience using LinkedIn for lead generation

Background in mission-driven or social impact projects

title: Inviting Senior Editors of EI Compendex Journals
description:
We are a seasoned academic service team dedicated to advancing international scholarly exchange and collaboration. To better support researchers worldwide in disseminating their work, we are now seeking experienced professionals like you—with a background as an editor or special issue organizer for EI Compendex-indexed journals —to join our expert team and contribute to elevating the quality and impact of academic papers.

We Are Looking For Candidates with the Following Profile:

  • A strong academic research background and a respected reputation in your field.
  • Must possess one of the following senior-level experiences:
  • Must currently be organizing and guest-editing a Special Issue for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.
  • Must currently be serving as an editor, associate editor, or editorial board member for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.

Your Role Will Include (Clear Academic Support Services):

  1. Academic Review & Deep Polishing: Evaluate manuscripts for scientific rigor, logic, and originality, while refining academic expression, flow, and terminology to meet international publication standards.
  2. Professional Translation & Grammar Polishing: Accurately translate Chinese research papers into natural, fluent academic English, ensuring correctness in grammar, spelling, and sentence structure.
  3. Figure Optimization: Ensure all figures, charts, and images in the manuscript comply with the technical requirements of target journals, including but not limited to: format, layout, resolution (DPI), color mode, and file size.
  4. Cover Letter Drafting: Assist authors in concisely summarizing the manuscript’s core strengths, innovations, and academic value in a compelling cover letter , enhancing its initial impression on journal editors.
  5. Submission Assistance: Based on the article’s specific content, academic quality, and research field, recommend suitable journals indexed in the EI Compendex database for the author’s reference and selection.

Our Commitment and Emphasis (Core Compliance):

  • Full Compliance: All services we provide are strictly for “academic support” and absolutely do not involve any form of ghostwriting, data fabrication, or plagiarism . Your work will focus solely on improving the quality of the author’s original manuscript, with all final decisions remaining with the author.
  • No Acceptance Guarantee: We do not and cannot guarantee that any manuscript will be accepted. The final decision on publication rests entirely with the journal’s editors and peer-review process. Submission assistance is solely a recommendation based on content and does not imply any outcome.
  • Respect for Academic Integrity: We strictly adhere to publishing ethics standards (e.g., COPE guidelines). Our services are designed to help authors overcome language, presentation, and technical barriers, not to replace their core research work.

By Joining Us, You Will Receive:

  • Competitive remuneration and flexible working hours that fully respect your academic schedule.
  • Opportunities to engage with cutting-edge research and exchange ideas with outstanding global scholars.
  • The professional satisfaction of contributing to clearer, more standardized, and influential scientific communication.

If our mission resonates with you, and you wish to leverage your senior experience to help more scholars share their work globally, we sincerely invite you to get in touch.

We look forward to partnering with you in upholding the beacon of academic excellence!

title: Consultor Tributário
description:
Consultor Tributário Pleno

Local: Belo Horizonte - MG

Regime: CLT

Área: Consultoria Tributária

Nível: Pleno

Sobre a posição

Buscamos um Consultor Tributário Pleno para atuar em análises estratégicas, planejamento tributário, elaboração de pareceres jurídico-contábeis e suporte consultivo a clientes de médio e grande porte. O profissional será responsável por conduzir projetos técnicos com autonomia, garantindo conformidade fiscal, segurança jurídica e eficiência tributária.

Responsabilidades
  • Realizar planejamento tributário em regimes de Lucro Real, Presumido e Simples Nacional , com foco em otimização fiscal e mitigação de riscos.
  • Elaborar pareceres jurídico-contábeis , notas técnicas e relatórios executivos.
  • Apoiar empresas na condução de processos administrativos e judiciais , especialmente relacionados a tributos federais, estaduais e municipais.
  • Realizar revisões fiscais (PIS/COFINS, IRPJ, CSLL, ICMS, ISS, IPI, INSS).
  • Avaliar oportunidades de créditos tributários , inclusive ICMS-ST , creditamento de IPI , exclusão do ICMS da base do PIS/COFINS , Lei do Bem , E-CREDAC/SP , entre outros.
  • Desenvolver modelos de simulação tributária , cenários comparativos e projeções financeiras.
  • Atuar em projetos de transação tributária , negociação de passivos fiscais e estruturação de garantias.
  • Realizar acompanhamento normativo e interpretar atualizações legislativas com impacto direto nos clientes.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e apresentações executivas.
  • Interagir com equipes de contabilidade, jurídico e controladoria dos clientes.
Obrigatórios
  • Formação em Contabilidade, Direito, Administração ou Economia .
  • Experiência mínima de 3 a 5 anos em consultoria tributária ou departamentos fiscais.
  • Domínio de IRPJ/CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ICMS e ISS .
  • Capacidade de elaborar pareceres técnicos e análises tributárias complexas.
  • Conhecimento sólido de legislação tributária federal, estadual e municipal .
  • Excel avançado (simulações, tabelas dinâmicas, cenários).
Desejáveis
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão Tributária .
  • Experiência com Tax Compliance , ECF , ECD , PER/DCOMP , DCTFWeb .
  • Vivência com planejamento societário , AFAC, reorganizações e holdings.
  • Conhecimento em MEP, custo de produção, subvenções para investimento e temas contábil-tributários avançados.
  • Facilidade para apresentações, relatórios executivos e comunicação com diretoria.
Competências Comportamentais
  • Raciocínio analítico e visão sistêmica.
  • Capacidade de traduzir temas complexos em linguagem executiva.
  • Proatividade e autonomia técnica.
  • Organização, senso de responsabilidade e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Perfil consultivo, relacionamento interpessoal e postura profissional.
Benefícios
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico
  • Vale-refeição/alimentação
  • Bônus por performance
  • Incentivo a cursos e certificações
